target: Paisaje de navegación del Borde de los Cardos en la Senda del Viento Bajo.
art_direction: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Transición visible donde aparecen vegetación de llanura y suelo más blando al salir de Korven hacia Edran.
prompt: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Create a wide landscape at Borde de los Cardos. Broken hard Korven ground in the foreground gradually gives way to softer earth, low thistle-like field vegetation and a broader travel track. Stone walls recede and the horizon opens toward Edran. The vegetation change itself is the landmark: irregular bands of hardy cardos establish the first unmistakable plain ecology without becoming a flower field. Natural wind, subdued daylight, dusty greens, gray-browns and restrained dry purples.
negative_constraints: No giant fantasy thistles or poisonous magical plants
No buildings, fences or invented ruins
No golden sunset or saturated fantasy palette
No characters or creatures as focal subject
